_meta.what: Real proposals from the value-chain and comparable agents, captured with the evidence snippet each one cites (Exa, 2026-10-16), labeled for whether THAT SNIPPET supports the statement.
_meta.labels: S = the snippet says or clearly implies it. U = the snippet does not back it (it may still be true in the world: TSMC does supply AMD, the cited snippet just does not say so). A = ambiguous, excluded from rates.
_meta.labeler: Claude, reading the snippet text, before seeing any Jev answer. Not a human. Treat as a first outside reading, not ground truth.
_meta.split: dev (4 tickers, 4 brands) first fixed the threshold at 0.2. held (4+4) then showed a supported claim at 0.16-0.22, so the default was lowered to 0.1: held is NOT clean for 0.1. fresh (5 tickers, 5 brands, captured and labeled before any Jev score was seen, scored once at the pre-fixed 0.1) is the clean check.
_meta.noise: Jev's score for the same claim varies between runs (median spread 0.05, p90 0.10, max 0.16 over 6 repeats), so a single run is a snapshot.
